comment: wintty.c tty_print_glyph() prints a glyph's UTF-8 customization (gm.u) only while SYMHANDLING(H_UTF8), the handling of the current graphics set. The SYMBOLS customizations belong to the primary set, Enhanced1; on the Rogue level gc.currentgraphics is ROGUESET, whose default handling is not UTF-8, so although reset_glyphmap() leaves gm.u attached, g_putch() prints the Rogue symbols' bytes. Level teleport to the Rogue level (debug mode) and ^F map it: C draws corridors as '#' and walls as '|'.
